=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
Requirement: The PR description, agents.md, changelog, and README all state that guard files come from the owner-reviewed `.claude/` tree, and that this tree is authoritative for guard files. The PR description says "A guard file is therefore copied from the same commit's .claude/ tree, never from its twin." The agents.md bullet says "copies that `.claude/` file instead of the twin." The security finding's threat model is that unreviewed twin content can reach consumers before the owner-sync PR lands.

Expected change site: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml` line 286 (the `find` that drives the sync loop) or a separate enumeration of reviewed guard paths; `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` line 16 (seed inventory)

Evidence of absence: The sync loop at line 286 iterates exclusively over the twin tree: `done < <(LC_ALL=C find "${CLAUDE_UPSTREAM_DIR}" -type f | LC_ALL=C sort)`, where `CLAUDE_UPSTREAM_DIR` is `workflow-templates/.claude/`. The guard-source switch in the `case` block at lines 253-272 only fires for paths the twin-driven loop encounters. A guard file that exists in `${CLAUDE_REVIEWED_DIR}` (the `.claude/` tree) but whose twin was deleted from `workflow-templates/.claude/` is never visited. A consumer that lacks this file after the twin deletion will not receive the reviewed copy. The test fixture `_run_claude_sync` feeds the twin tree as the directory `find` enumerates; no test covers a guard present in `reviewed` but absent from `twins`. The seed-repo.md at line 16 defines the inventory as "The whole `workflow-templates/.claude/` tree" and only substitutes the source for guard paths present in that twin inventory. Copilot review comments 4150656157 and 4150656195 on the current head identify the same gap.

Mitigation: The plan explicitly lists `ci.yml` promotion skip, `claude-twin-sync.yml`, and `claude_twin_sync.py` as non-goals, deferring to sibling findings #5608 and #5609 which would prevent a guard twin deletion from reaching `stable` without the corresponding `.claude/` sync. On the base branch today, every guard twin equals its `.claude/` copy, so no guard exists in the reviewed tree without a twin. The primary security path (unreviewed twin additions or content changes reaching consumers) is properly gated by this PR.

SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | lines 247-255, 286 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sync loop enumerates only files present in the twin tree (workflow-templates/.claude/), switching to the owner-reviewed .claude/ source only for guard paths encountered in that twin tree. If an unapproved twin deletion removes a guard file from workflow-templates/.claude/ while the owner-reviewed .claude/ copy still exists on stable, the loop never visits that path.
  WHY: An unapproved PR that deletes a guard twin (such as pr_watch_guard.py or settings.json) can reach stable by promotion while the owner-only .claude/ sync PR is still pending. A consumer lacking that guard file will not receive the reviewed .claude/ copy (and no warning is logged), allowing an unapproved twin deletion to suppress a required enforcement guard.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md | line 16 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The seed command defines the asset inventory as the whole workflow-templates/.claude/ tree and only substitutes the source for guard paths within that twin-derived inventory.
  WHY: If an unapproved twin deletion removes a guard file while the owner-reviewed .claude/ copy remains on stable, the guard is omitted from the seed file set. Newly seeded consumer repositories are created without the reviewed enforcement hook or settings file, even when referenced by settings.json.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
Requirement: "A guard file is therefore copied from the same commit's .claude/ tree, never from its twin" (PR description, line 4) and "A guard file that exists only as a twin is not installed" (changelog, `changelog.d/5607-consumer-guard-source.md`). The security finding (#5607, unapproved-guard-twin-reaches-consumers) requires the consumer sync to source guard files from the owner-reviewed `.claude/` tree, not the twin. The PR description's five "Done when" cases enumerate: "guard equal → copied from `.claude/`; guard twin differs + consumer has file → kept; guard twin differs + consumer lacks file → `.claude/` copy installed; guard missing from `.claude/` → skipped; non-guard → copied from twin." The inverse case — guard present in `.claude/` but absent from the twin — is not listed and not implemented.
Expected change site: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml` "Sync .claude/ assets from upstream" step, the `while IFS= read -r -d '' upstream_path` loop (around lines 244-285). The loop is driven by `find "${CLAUDE_UPSTREAM_DIR}" -type f | LC_ALL=C sort` (line ~230) where `CLAUDE_UPSTREAM_DIR` is the twin tree. `rel` is derived from the twin path only (`upstream_path#${CLAUDE_UPSTREAM_DIR}/`), so a guard file present in `${CLAUDE_REVIEWED_DIR}` (the `.claude/` tree) but deleted from the twin is never visited. The mirror gap exists in `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` line 16, which defines the seed inventory as the whole `workflow-templates/.claude/` tree and only substitutes the source for guard paths present in that twin inventory.
Evidence of absence: The new `case` arm at lines 251-272 only fires for paths the twin contains; the `claude_source_path` switch and the `cmp`/`diff`/`cp` block at lines 274-282 are reached solely through the twin-driven loop. No second pass enumerates `CLAUDE_REVIEWED_DIR` guard files independently. The behavioral test `test_claude_sync_takes_guard_files_from_the_reviewed_claude_tree` (`tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py:351-432`) covers six twin-present directions but contains no fixture where the `reviewed` dict is broader than `twins`; the inverse case cannot fire under the suite. The parity test at `tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py:302-322` only checks that the shell `case` pattern string appears in the script and runs the pattern against a fixed sample list — it does not exercise the missing-twin path. The plan's non-goals (`docs/plans/issue-5607-guard-assets-from-claude-tree-plan.md:35-37`) defer `ci.yml`, `claude-twin-sync.yml`, and `scripts/claude_twin_sync.py` to sibling findings #5608/#5609, but the consumer-sync gap is the inverse of the threat the PR exists to mitigate: an unreviewed twin change can now reach consumers either as content (the existing guard case) or as a deletion that silently suppresses a reviewed guard. Copilot review comments 4150656157 (on `update_workflows.yml:255`) and 4150656195 (on `seed-repo.md:16`) name this exact case; the PR comment context records three independent reviewers (deepseek-v4-pro, gpt-6-luna, glm-5.2) classifying it MAJOR/high and the consolidated pass-1 ledger (CONSENSUS FINDINGS) lists it as the only MAJOR cross-pollination item.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
